options.summary: Build a local HTTP endpoint first, then expose it in a later gated phase with a short-lived HTTPS tunnel.
strengths: keeps project runtime as sales brain
temporary per-call tool can avoid durable dashboard setup during early testing
risks: tunnel provider logging and URL leakage risk
must stop tunnel immediately after run

options.summary: Run the tool in a browser or client app rather than exposing a server endpoint.
strengths: fits a future browser or WebRTC demo
risks: requires web client or SDK work
less direct for the next hosted sandbox
needs separate client-side auth and evidence handling

options.summary: Use a real-time websocket/server-side data connection for richer tool interaction.
strengths: can support richer real-time state handoff
risks: not first sandbox path unless HTTP tools are blocked

risk_controls: no public tunnel in this phase
dashboard/durable tool waits until endpoint schema is stable
